summary: The old harness has a preexisting Minify coverage gap that remains after the change. The selected edits add local pointer clearing and establish no new harness obligation. Full coverage remains unresolved because the delegated build script and allocator defaults were not supplied.

claims.necessity_reason: Minify is an entry operation. The finite input `1000//\n\0` passes the harness input checks. Minify supports reducing its comment-only body to an empty string, but the harness returns when parsing that body fails, before it calls Minify. A parsed JSON value cannot yield the same empty whole-input result.

before.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to reduce a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string.
before.reason: Minify consumes the comment and newline. The parser rejects the initial slash, so the harness returns before Minify.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Consumes the single-line comment through its newline.
The complete value dispatch rejects an initial slash.
Failed value parsing returns no JSON item.

after.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to reduce a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string.
after.reason: The same Minify behavior remains supported, and the same parse-success gate prevents the call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Consumes the single-line comment through its newline.
The complete value dispatch still rejects an initial slash.
Failed value parsing still returns no JSON item.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The only Minify call follows the parse-success check.

claims.comparison_reason: The same whole-input comment behavior exists on both sides. The same old-harness parse gate blocks it on both sides; a parsed JSON prefix followed by a comment cannot produce an empty whole-input result.

missing_information: The supplied build.sh delegates to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, whose contents are absent. Its target compilation and configuration are decisive for complete build coverage.
The global allocator-hook initialization is absent, so compatibility between returned print buffers and the harness's free call cannot be fully assessed.
